name: Payroll System Outage at Cutoff
description: Simulates the impact of asset_payroll_engine experiencing an unexpected 12-hour outage precisely during the bi-weekly payroll cutoff window. Drives manual fallback interventions and delays general ledger close.

shocks.rationale: System down forces 100% manual check calculations.
Flat 12-hour wait delay inserted into the process due to system downtime.
Manual calculations cause a 5x spike in payroll defects requiring later correction.
